features.name: HTTP success status
features.description: Whether the page request ended in a 2xx response.
features.rationale: Pages that do not return success cannot be read, cited or retrieved.
features.measurement: Final HTTP status of the page fetch.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every fetched page. A transport failure or an unfollowed redirect gives no final status, so it is not_measured.
features.method: pass if the FetchRecord outcome is success; not_measured for HTTP 429, and for 503 with Retry-After (the server is throttling this crawl, which says nothing about the page); fail for any other http_error (4xx/5xx); otherwise not_measured with the reason.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Reflects one fetch from one vantage point at one time; intermittent errors are not detected.
A 403 may be bot blocking of the audit crawler rather than a page defect; it is still reported as a failure because the crawler cannot tell the two apart.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Fix the server error or restore/redirect the missing page.

features.name: Crawlable page links
features.description: Whether the page exposes at least one followable (http/https anchor, not rel=nofollow) link.
features.rationale: A page without followable links is a dead end for crawlers discovering the rest of the site.
features.measurement: Count of followable anchors in the extracted document.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with an extracted document.
features.method: pass if followable anchors >= min_crawlable_links, else fail. Anchors with rel=nofollow are not followable; javascript:, mailto: and fragment-only links are excluded by extraction. Documents from the older extractor fall back to the plain link list.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Links created by JavaScript are not in the static HTML and are not seen.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Add normal <a href> links to related pages.

overlaps.distinction: F002 is a binary dead-end test; F071 normalises internal links by text length.
F002 asks whether any followable link exists; F073 reports the internal/external counts.

features.name: Robots.txt accessibility
features.description: Whether robots.txt can be retrieved (or is cleanly absent) for each origin.
features.rationale: RFC 9309 tells crawlers to treat an unreachable robots.txt (server or network error) as a complete disallow.
features.measurement: HTTP outcome of the robots.txt fetch per origin.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per contributing page, origin or file, with its URL.
features.applicability: Each origin whose robots.txt was fetched; not_measured when the crawl did not fetch it.
features.method: pass if 2xx or 4xx (RFC 9309: absent means allowed); fail if 5xx; not_measured on transport failure or an unfollowed redirect.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Does not judge the content of the file; see F004.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Make robots.txt return 200 (or 404 if none is intended), never 5xx.

features.name: Robots policy compliance
features.description: Whether robots.txt permits the audited page for the configured crawler tokens.
features.rationale: Compliant crawlers obey robots.txt, so a disallow rule keeps them from fetching the page. Whether that is wanted is the site owner's decision.
features.measurement: List of configured user-agent tokens that are disallowed for the page URL.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages whose origin has a readable robots.txt; not_measured otherwise.
features.method: Parse the stored robots.txt with the RFC 9309 matcher (wildcards, longest match) and test the page URL for each token in audit_agent_tokens and ai_crawler_tokens; report `warning` (confirm intent) if any is disallowed. A robots.txt that is unreadable, or whose stored body cannot be read, is not_measured.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. Blocking a crawler is often a deliberate policy; it is reported as a notice to confirm, not scored as a defect.
limitations: Token list is configuration, not an authoritative registry of AI crawlers; blocking may be intentional.
A notice only: the audit cannot tell whether the block is deliberate.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Confirm that blocking these agents is intended. If the page should be reachable by them, narrow or remove the matching Disallow rules.

features.name: Meta robots directives
features.description: Whether the page's meta robots tag forbids indexing.
features.rationale: A noindex directive asks search engines not to index the page; AI systems that draw on those indexes may then not retrieve it (that dependence is not measured here).
features.measurement: Directive tokens in <meta name=robots>.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with an extracted document. An absent tag means no restriction and passes.
features.method: Report `warning` (confirm intent) if the tokens include noindex or none; pass otherwise.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. noindex is often deliberate (thank-you pages, staging, internal search); it is reported as a notice to confirm, not scored as a defect.
limitations: A notice only: the audit cannot tell whether the directive is deliberate.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Confirm the restriction is intended. If the page should appear in search results, remove noindex/none.

overlaps.distinction: F005 reads the HTML tag; F006 reads the HTTP header.
F005 covers indexing; F030 covers snippet restrictions.

features.name: X-Robots-Tag directives
features.description: Whether the X-Robots-Tag response header forbids indexing.
features.rationale: Header directives apply to any file type, including ones that have no HTML to carry a robots tag.
features.measurement: Directive tokens in the X-Robots-Tag header.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every fetched page with a response. Absent header passes.
features.method: Split the header on commas; ignore an optional leading 'agent:' scope when reporting; report `warning` (confirm intent) on noindex or none.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. noindex is often deliberate; it is reported as a notice to confirm, not scored as a defect.
limitations: Agent-specific directives are reported but treated as applying to the page.
A notice only: the audit cannot tell whether the directive is deliberate.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Confirm the restriction is intended. If the page should be indexed, remove noindex/none from the X-Robots-Tag header.

features.name: Sitemap availability
features.description: Whether the site declares a sitemap in robots.txt.
features.rationale: Sitemaps help crawlers find pages that internal links do not reach.
features.measurement: Sitemap URLs declared by robots.txt Sitemap: lines.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per contributing page, origin or file, with its URL.
features.applicability: Origins with a readable robots.txt.
features.method: pass if at least one Sitemap: directive is declared; otherwise not_measured (default sitemap locations are not probed, so absence is not concluded).
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. Only declaration is checked; the sitemap file itself is not fetched.
limitations: Availability of the file is not verified because the crawler does not fetch sitemaps yet.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.

overlaps.distinction: F007 asks whether a sitemap is declared; F008 compares its URL list with crawled pages.

features.name: Sitemap URL coverage
features.description: Share of sitemap URLs that were crawled, and of crawled pages listed in the sitemap.
features.rationale: Mismatches reveal undiscovered, orphaned or stale URLs.
features.measurement: Ratio of sitemap URLs found among crawled pages and vice versa.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per contributing page, origin or file, with its URL.
features.applicability: Sites with a fetchable sitemap.
features.method: Parse sitemap XML safely and compare normalised URL sets.
blocked_by: The crawler does not fetch or parse sitemaps (Stage 01 limitation).
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Not yet measured, so excluded from scores. Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: None beyond the stated method.
features.test_requirements: Contract test: the engine must report not_measured with the blocked_by reason. Evaluation before implementing: fixture sitemaps with partial overlap.

features.name: Orphan-page risk
features.description: Whether a crawled page has no incoming internal links from other crawled pages.
features.rationale: Pages that nothing links to cannot be found by following links, so link-following crawlers do not reach them.
features.measurement: Number of distinct other pages linking to the page.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page except the entry page. Pages found only through a sitemap are not yet considered.
features.method: fail if zero distinct other crawled pages link to the page (after following redirects to the final URL). not_measured while any other page's link list is incomplete (truncated, capped or not extracted), because the missing links may point here.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: A breadth-first crawl discovers every page through a link from another crawled page, so this check cannot fail on a crawl-discovered page; it does not contribute to the aggregate score until URLs are also discovered by another source (sitemap, F008).
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Link to the page from relevant hub or related pages.

overlaps.distinction: F009 is the zero-incoming risk flag; F072 compares incoming links with a configured minimum.

features.name: Crawl depth
features.description: Minimum number of link clicks from the entry page to the page.
features.rationale: Pages many clicks from the entry page are reached later by link-following crawlers; any effect on ranking or citation is not measured here.
features.measurement: Shortest link distance from the entry page in the crawled link graph.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every reachable page; unreachable pages are not_measured.
features.method: Breadth-first search over internal links of crawled documents; pass if depth <= max_click_depth. A failure is not_measured while any page's link list is incomplete, because a shorter path may exist.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: The threshold is a configurable policy default, not a ranking rule.
The crawl only reaches pages within its own depth bound; when that bound is not larger than max_click_depth the check cannot fail and does not contribute to the aggregate score.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Link to the page from pages closer to the entry page.

features.name: Canonical tag presence
features.description: Whether the page declares a canonical URL.
features.rationale: Without a canonical, duplicates of a page compete and signals are split.
features.measurement: The rel=canonical href.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with an extracted document.
features.method: pass if canonical_url is present and non-blank; fail if absent or blank.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Canonicals set only by HTTP Link headers are not read.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to the preferred URL.

features.name: Canonical target validity
features.description: Whether the canonical URL is well-formed and, when crawled, a healthy page.
features.rationale: A canonical pointing at a broken, relative or non-indexable URL is ignored or harmful.
features.measurement: Resolved canonical URL and the crawl status of its target.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages that declare a canonical.
features.method: Resolve against the page URL; fail if not an absolute http(s) URL, has a fragment, or the crawled target answered with a 404/410-class error or is noindex; pass if the crawled target is healthy. not_measured if the target was not crawled, was redirected away, timed out, or answered with a server error or an access/rate-limit status, because reachability is then unknown.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Reachability is judged only for canonical targets that were crawled; an uncrawled or unreachable target is reported as not measured, never as a pass.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Point the canonical at an absolute, indexable, 200-status URL.

features.name: Canonical consistency
features.description: Whether the canonical points to itself or to a self-canonical target (no chains or loops).
features.rationale: Chains and loops make it unclear which URL is preferred.
features.measurement: Relationship between the page, its canonical and the target's canonical.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages that declare a canonical. Non-self canonicals whose target was not crawled are not_measured.
features.method: pass if canonical equals the page URL, or the crawled target's own canonical is itself; fail if the target canonicalises elsewhere.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: None beyond the stated method.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Make the final target self-canonical and point all duplicates at it.

overlaps.distinction: F012 validates one canonical URL; F013 compares canonicals across pages.

features.name: Duplicate page content
features.description: Whether another crawled page has identical normalised text.
features.rationale: Duplicates dilute signals and make citations ambiguous.
features.measurement: Pages sharing the SHA-256 of normalised visible text.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with at least duplicate_min_text_chars of text; shorter pages are not_applicable.
features.method: Group pages by hash of lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed text; fail if the group has more than one page.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Exact duplicates only; near-duplicates are not detected.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Consolidate duplicates with redirects or canonicals, or differentiate the content.

overlaps.distinction: F014 compares body text; F022 compares titles.
F014 finds identical text; F080 flags heavily overlapping topics.

features.name: Redirect-chain length
features.description: Number of redirect hops between the requested URL and the final URL.
features.rationale: Long chains waste crawl budget and risk being abandoned.
features.measurement: Count of followed redirect hops.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages whose request was redirected; a page that was not redirected is not_applicable.
features.method: pass if hops <= max_redirect_hops; fail above it.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: The threshold is a policy default, not a ranking rule.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Redirect directly to the final URL.

features.name: Redirect-loop detection
features.description: Whether the redirect chain revisits a URL.
features.rationale: A loop makes the page unreachable.
features.measurement: Whether a hop target equals an earlier URL.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages that were redirected or ended in too_many_redirects; others are not_applicable.
features.method: Resolve each Location against its hop URL; fail if a target was already visited.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: A chain that exceeds the crawler's hop limit without repeating is reported as no loop.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Break the loop so the chain ends at a 200 page.

features.name: Broken internal links
features.description: Internal links on the page whose crawled target returned an HTTP error.
features.rationale: Broken links waste crawler effort and signal neglect.
features.measurement: Broken internal links among those whose targets were crawled.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with at least one internal link whose target was crawled; otherwise not_measured.
features.method: Map each internal link to its fetch via requested/final URL; fail if any target answered with an HTTP error that says the page is missing (4xx other than 401/403/407/429). Targets that answered 401/403/407/429 or a 5xx are refused or failing, not shown to be missing, so they are neither counted as checked nor as broken.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Only crawled targets are checked; links beyond the crawl limits are unknown, not good.
A target that blocked or throttled the audit agent is not judged.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Update or remove links to missing pages.

overlaps.distinction: F017 is per page; F079 describes how broken links concentrate across the site.

features.name: URL parameter proliferation
features.description: Number of query parameters in the page URL and in the internal URLs the page links to.
features.rationale: Many parameters create duplicate URL variants.
features.measurement: Largest query-parameter count among the page URL and its internal link targets.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every fetched page. Link targets are judged when the page has an extracted document.
features.method: pass if the page URL and every internal link target have <= max_query_parameters parameters; fail otherwise. The crawler does not fetch URLs with query strings by default, so linked URLs are inspected without being crawled.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Judged on URL text only; whether a parameter changes the content is not known.
A truncated or capped link list may hide linked URLs with many parameters.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Use clean paths; keep tracking and faceting parameters out of linked URLs.

features.name: URL semantic readability
features.description: Whether path segments are human-readable words.
features.rationale: Readable URLs help users and systems understand a page before fetching it.
features.measurement: Share of path segments that look like words.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with a non-root path.
features.method: A segment is unreadable if it is hex/UUID-like, mostly digits, or longer than max_url_segment_chars; fail if any is unreadable.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. Readability is a heuristic with no accepted universal criterion.
limitations: English-centric heuristic; non-Latin slugs may be misjudged.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.

features.name: HTTPS consistency
features.description: Whether the page is served over HTTPS and internal links keep HTTPS.
features.rationale: Mixed schemes fragment URLs and weaken trust signals.
features.measurement: Final scheme and count of http:// internal links.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every fetched page with a final URL.
features.method: fail if the final URL is http, or the extracted document links to the same site over http://.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: None beyond the stated method.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Serve every page over HTTPS and update internal links.

overlaps.distinction: F020 checks URL schemes; F110 checks transport security headers.

features.name: Title presence
features.description: Whether the page has a non-empty <title>.
features.rationale: The title is the primary label for a page in search and citation.
features.measurement: The title text.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with an extracted document.
features.method: pass if the title is present and non-blank; fail if absent or blank.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `high`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: None beyond the stated method.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Add a unique, descriptive <title>.

features.name: Title uniqueness
features.description: Whether the page's title is shared by no other crawled page.
features.rationale: Identical titles make pages indistinguishable in results and citations.
features.measurement: Other pages with the same normalised title.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with a non-blank title.
features.method: Compare lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed titles; fail if another page matches.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `medium`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: None beyond the stated method.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Give each page a distinct title.

overlaps.distinction: F022 compares titles; F014 compares body text.

features.name: Title descriptiveness
features.description: Whether the title is more than a generic placeholder.
features.rationale: Generic titles ('Home', 'Untitled') say nothing about the page.
features.measurement: Whether the normalised title matches the generic-title list or has no letters.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with a non-blank title.
features.method: fail if the title is in generic_titles or has no alphabetic character.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Heuristic; says nothing about quality beyond placeholder detection. The list is configuration.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Name the page's subject in the title.

overlaps.distinction: F021 asks whether a title exists; F023 asks whether it is a placeholder.

features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.

features.name: Description-content alignment
features.description: Whether the description's terms appear in the page text.

features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Pages with a non-blank description and text.
features.method: Tokenise, drop English stopwords, and compute the covered share; pass if >= description_term_coverage_min.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Lexical overlap only; English stopwords; synonyms count as mismatches. Threshold is a policy default to calibrate.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.

features.name: Language declaration

features.applicability: Every page with an extracted document.

features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.

features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.

features.name: Character encoding declaration
features.description: Whether the character encoding is declared by the HTTP header or a <meta charset>.
features.rationale: Undeclared encodings risk garbled text in crawlers that guess.

features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with a response. A level-1 document cannot show a <meta charset>, so an undeclared header is not_measured for it.
features.method: pass if Content-Type has a charset or the document has charset_declared; fail if neither (detail level 2); not_measured without a response or for a level-1 document without a header charset.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. Many modern servers rely on the UTF-8 default; reported for context.
limitations: Does not verify that the declared charset matches the bytes.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.

features.name: Viewport configuration
features.description: Whether <meta name=viewport> exists with width=device-width and without disabled zoom.
features.rationale: Viewport configuration controls mobile rendering and text scaling.
features.measurement: The viewport content value and its parsed directives.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every page with a level-2 document.
features.method: Parse the viewport content into key=value directives; fail if absent, if width is not device-width, or if user-scalable=no / maximum-scale<=1 disables zoom.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Scored: each measured unit counts pass=1, fail=0; not_applicable, not_measured and error units are excluded from the denominator and reported as coverage.
limitations: Only the declared tag is judged, not how the page renders.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and do not disable zoom.

overlaps.distinction: F029 checks the declared tag; F106 checks actual mobile rendering support.

features.name: Search snippet restrictions
features.description: Whether snippet-limiting directives are set.
features.rationale: nosnippet and max-snippet limit what answer systems may quote.
features.measurement: Snippet directives from meta robots and X-Robots-Tag.
features.evidence_requirements: One EvidenceRef per result quoting the observed value (or stating its absence) with the page URL and the fetch time.
features.applicability: Every fetched page.
features.method: Report `warning` (confirm intent) if nosnippet or max-snippet:0 is present; pass otherwise.
features.severity_policy: A failing result has severity `low`; a finding takes the highest severity among its failing results.
features.scoring_policy: Unscored (informational): measured and reported with coverage but excluded from scores. Snippet limits are usually a deliberate publishing choice; reported as a notice to confirm, not scored as a defect.
limitations: data-nosnippet attributes on elements are not extracted. Restriction may be intentional.
A notice only: the audit cannot tell whether the directive is deliberate.
features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
features.remediation: Confirm the restriction is intended. If the page should be quotable, remove nosnippet / max-snippet:0.

overlaps.distinction: F005 covers indexing; F030 covers quoting.

features.test_requirements: Unit tests with deterministic fixtures for pass, fail, not_applicable, not_measured and malformed-input cases; evidence provenance asserted.
